items.text: The earth is but one country, and mankind its citizens.
items.author: Bahá’u’lláh
items.source_ref: Gleanings from the Writings of Bahá’u’lláh, CXVII

items.text: Truthfulness is the foundation of all human virtues.
items.author: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá
items.source_ref: Tablet of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá; cited in The Advent of Divine Justice

items.text: Regard man as a mine rich in gems of inestimable value.
items.author: Bahá’u’lláh
items.source_ref: Gleanings from the Writings of Bahá’u’lláh, CXXII

items.text: Service to humanity is service to God.
items.author: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá
items.source_ref: The Promulgation of Universal Peace, 12 April 1912 (Studio of Miss Phillips, New York)
